question: What changes when a serial consumer shares a marked clock’s actual parents, and what can an unguarded serial rule do to that mark?
forbidden_inputs: Future groups or supplied scorer labels cannot grant raw eligibility or recognition of a clock turn.
primary_observable: Marked turns per physical birth at matched boundaries, donor loose counts before and after each competing birth, and irreversible loss of a structurally matched raw event.
cheapest_meaningful_control: On the same paid start, fire the marked tick first versus an actual competitor at a common donor. Compare the other-continuation placement.
first_executable_signal: The marked deletion parents are physically present on the first prepared cut and both laws admit their exact birth.
resource_budget: Two registered tick depths, two laws, four raw search steps and at most 200 expanded states per first-cut search cell. Register any heavier-than-ten-minute check with the coordinator.
stop_rule: Matched different tick counts per actual birth, or a proof that the funded clock’s ticks are unaffected in the registered class. Then validate the next turn and separately report the bounded raw probes.
decision_or_followup_rule: The funded theorem is mathematical evidence. A warm raw permanent loss concerns a switch at a physically reached cut. A censored targeting strategy makes no statement about all raw orders.
